description: This file defines the `GatewayDeviceAuthPayload` enum with static methods for constructing device authentication payloads, normalizing metadata fields, and signing device dictionaries in a device authentication context.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Builds a version 3 device authentication payload string with provided parameters, serializing various fields separated by '|'.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes a metadata string by trimming whitespace and converting uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase for deterministic cross-runtime normalization.

methods.name: signedDeviceDictionary
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with signed device information, including signature, public key, and metadata, using external signing methods.
